title: Play GTA 6 for Less: Book a Gaming Cafe Slot on Hash
description: Want to play GTA 6 without buying a PS5 or Xbox and a ₹5,999 game? Book a console slot at a gaming cafe near you on the Hash app and pay only for your time.

body.text: GTA 6 is the biggest game launch of the decade, but playing it at home is not cheap. The Standard Edition costs ₹5,999 in India, and the game runs only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, so if you do not already own one of those consoles, the real cost of playing GTA 6 is the console plus the game. There is a cheaper way: play it at a gaming cafe and pay only for the hours you play.
Why a gaming cafe is the cheapest way to play GTA 6

items: No console to buy: the cafe already has a PS5 or Xbox, a big screen and a controller ready.
No ₹5,999 game to buy up front: you pay the cafe's slot rate for the time you play.
Try before you buy: play a few sessions and decide if you want your own copy later.
Play with friends: book side-by-side slots and play together on launch week.

body.text: How to book a GTA 6 slot on the Hash app

items: Open the Hash app and go to gaming cafes near you.
Compare cafes by their PC and console setups and their per-slot rates.
Pick a cafe with a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S and choose your time.
Reserve the slot in advance so the console is ready when you arrive.

body.text: Not every cafe will have GTA 6 installed on day one, so check the cafe's listing or call ahead before you book.
Earn HashCoins every time you book
Every booking on Hash earns you HashCoins. You can redeem them on passes, offers and gear, so each GTA 6 session also brings your next one a little closer.
Launch week slots will fill fast. Open the Hash app, find a cafe near you and lock your GTA 6 slot before you leave home.
